mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved for two consecutive weeks (-18.0 to -13.9) tracking a steady recovery in WORKPLACES (-28.6 to -17.7). This continuation of workplace re-engagement is expected to keep lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as commuting-linked shopping and dining resume.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's 28-day forward mean is lower than its trailing 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES continuing to rise, the always-on trend linkage is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained week-on-week rise in TRANSIT of more than 5 points signals relaxation of movement restrictions or reduced caution, which should precede a rebound in RETAIL_REC within two weeks as public transport use re-enables retail trips.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 5 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises by more than 5 points for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC's subsequent two-week mean does not increase, the threshold mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: Declining RESIDENTIAL (10.1 to 6.1) combined with rising WORKPLACES indicates people are spending less time at home and more time in external routines; jointly these reinforce increased discretionary retail visits, producing a stronger RETAIL_REC rise than either series alone would predict.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls while WORKPLACES rises simultaneously for two weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL and WORKPLACES move in the hypothesized joint direction but RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean does not exceed its trailing mean, the interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-February in Victoria coincides with post-summer-holiday return to routine and school term start; this seasonal behavioral shift typically increases structured outings including retail trips, supporting a rise in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks specifically during this school-return regime.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date is 2022-02-15, within the Australian school-term-start seasonal window
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean fails to rise despite the seasonal school-return period, the seasonal mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has been volatile (-8.1, -19.9, -15.9, -14.0); a sharp rebound in PARKS above -10 would indicate renewed outdoor and public-space activity, which tends to spill over into nearby retail and recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -10 from a lower prior week
failure_condition: If PARKS crosses above -10 but RETAIL_REC's following week mean does not increase relative to the prior week, the threshold mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: The steady week-on-week improvement in WORKPLACES (-26.9 to -17.7) reflects easing of work-from-home mandates or restriction policy, which structurally supports continued recovery in RETAIL_REC as commuters resume lunch and after-work shopping routines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES continues improving but RETAIL_REC's 28-day forward mean does not exceed its trailing mean, the always-on policy-linked mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT (-56.9 to -49.7) and WORKPLACES (-28.6 to -17.7) suggests a joint normalization of commuting behavior that compounds to drive faster recovery in RETAIL_REC than either trend alone, especially over a short two-week window.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve jointly but RETAIL_REC's two-week forward mean does not rise faster than its trailing two-week mean, the interaction hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: In a steady-state endemic regime following the Omicron wave peak, GROCERY_PHARM has remained flat near baseline (0.6-1.1), indicating essential-goods behavior has normalized; under this steady-state regime, residual caution fades and RETAIL_REC is expected to decline in growth momentum within one week as the sharp initial rebound plateaus.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC continues to rise at the same or faster pace in the next week despite flat GROCERY_PHARM, the plateau mechanism is rejected.
